title: ENGINEERING DESIGN
description: Execution of a project involving the design, fabrication, and performance testing of an actual engineering device or system
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( MECE E3420 ) MECE E3420 Building on the preliminary design concept, the detailed elements of the design process are completed: systems synthesis, design analysis optimization, incorporation of multiple constraints, compliance with appropriate engineering codes and standards, and Computer Aided Design (CAD) component part drawings.
